theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (U N : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (ι : Euclid d →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid P), IsOpen U → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 d N → x ∈ N ∩ U → Set.range ι = tangentSpace N x → ∃ (u : Euclid d → Euclid P) (δ₁ δ₂ : ℝ), 0 < δ₁ ∧ 0 < δ₂ ∧ closedBall x (δ₁ + δ₂) ⊆ U ∧ u 0 = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ u 0 = 0 ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 2 u (ball 0 δ₁) ∧ (∀ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid d) δ₁, (∀ w : Euclid d, inner ℝ (ι w) (u v) = 0) ∧ ‖fderiv ℝ u v‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖u v‖ < δ₂ / 2 ∧ x + ι v + u v ∈ N) ∧ ∀ (v : Euclid d) (h : Euclid P), ‖v‖ < δ₁ → ‖h‖ < δ₂ → (∀ w : Euclid d, inner ℝ (ι w) h = 0) → x + ι v + h ∈ N → h = u v
